# portainer_docker_container_gpus (Data Source)

Reports the GPUs assigned to a single container.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "portainer_docker_container_gpus" "trainer" {
  environment_id = 1
  container_id   = "b3f1a2c4d5e6"
}

output "trainer_gpus" {
  value = data.portainer_docker_container_gpus.trainer.gpus
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `container_id` (String) Identifier of the container to inspect.
- `environment_id` (Number) Environment (endpoint) identifier of the Docker environment the container runs in.

### Read-Only

- `gpus` (String) GPUs assigned to the container, as Portainer reports them. Empty when the container has none.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the resource.
